paite: Zawlnei Jeremiah in Jerusalem a kipan a saltang upate, siampute, zawlneite, midangte, Nebukadnezzar in Jerusalem a kipan a Babulon a api khit, akhosuaksunte kiang a alaikhak thu hiai ahi:
heading: Saltangte Kiang A Jeremiah Laikhak
english: Now these are the words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the residue of the elders of the captivity, and to the priests, to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon,

paite: Kumpipa Jekoniahte, kumpinute, michilgehte, Judah leh Jerusalem heutute, mikhutsiamte, siksek mite Jerusalem apaikhiak nung ua;
english: (after Jeconiah the king, the queen mother, the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, the craftsmen, and the smiths had departed from Jerusalem),

paite: Shaphan tapa, Elasah leh Hilkiah tapa, Gemariahte khut ah akhak hi; amaute bel Judah kumpipa Zedekiah in Babulon gam a Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar kiang a asawlte ahi uh.
english: by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan and Gemariah the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon). It said:

paite: Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N saltang tengteng, Jerusalem a kipan Babulon sal dia ka pisaksate kiang ah hichi in achi:
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says to all the captives whom I have caused to be carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon:

paite: Inn lam unla, huai ah teng un, huan bawl unla, agah ne un, zi nei unla, tanute tapate nei un.
english: “Build houses and dwell in them. Plant gardens and eat their fruit.

paite: Na tapate uh zi neisak unla, na tanute uh pasal neisak unla, tanu tapa aneihtheihna ding un; huai ah va pung unla, kiam lam nawt kei un;
english: Take wives and father sons and daughters. Take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters. Multiply there, and don’t be diminished.

paite: sal dia ka hon tansakna khopi hoihna ding zong unla, TOUPA kiang ah ngetsak un; ama hoihna ah nou leng hoihna na mu ding uhi.
english: Seek the peace of the city where I have caused you to be carried away captive, and pray to Yahweh for it; for in its peace you will have peace.”

paite: Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Na lak ua zawlneite leh aisan siamte'n hon khem kei uhenla, amang mat uh leng ngaikhe sam kei un.
english: For Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Don’t let your prophets who are among you and your diviners deceive you. Don’t listen to your dreams which you cause to be dreamed.

paite: Ka min sial in zuauthu na kiang ah agen uhi; kei sawl ahi kei uh, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For they prophesy falsely to you in my name. I have not sent them,” says Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi ngal a, Babulon a ding in kum sawmsagih achin chiang in ka hong veh ding a, na kiang ua ka thuchiam hoihtak ka tungsak ding, hiai mun ah ka hon kiksak nawn ding.
english: For Yahweh says, “After seventy years are accomplished for Babylon, I will visit you and perform my good word toward you, in causing you to return to this place.

paite: Nou lam a ka lungsim putdan ka kithei hi, na hun nanung tawp ua lametna leh tunung hon pe ding in thil hoih lou hilou in hoihna ngaihtuah ka hi.
english: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.

paite: Huan na hon kan ding ua, ka kiang ah na hong thum ding ua, ka hon ngaikhe ding hi.
english: You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you.

paite: Na hon zong ding ua, na lungtang tengteng ua na hon zon hun chiang un na hon mu ding uh.
english: You shall seek me and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.

paite: Huchi in na hon muh un ka om ding, TOUPA thupawt in achi, "Na vangphatnate uh ka tungding nawn ding a, nam tengteng lak a ka hon dalhsakna mun a kipan ka hon pikhawm nawn ding, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi; sal dia ka hon matsakna mun ngei ah ka hon tungsak nawn ding," chi in.
english: I will be found by you,” says Yahweh, “and I will turn again your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places where I have driven you,” says Yahweh. “I will bring you again to the place from where I caused you to be carried away captive.”

paite: "TOUPA'N Babulon gam ah leng zawlnei ahon bawlsak," na chi uhi.
english: Because you have said, “Yahweh has raised us up prophets in Babylon,”

paite: TOUPA'N David tutphah ah kumpipa tungtang thu leh hiai khopi a teng mipi tengteng, sal dia pi tel louh, na unaute uh tungtang thu ah hichi in achi:
english: Yahweh says concerning the king who sits on David’s throne, and concerning all the people who dwell in this city, your brothers who haven’t gone with you into captivity,

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai un, atung uah namsau, kial leh hipi in ka delhzui ding a, theipi hut, ahoih louh mahmah ziak a nek tuak het lou bang mai in ka bawl ding.
english: Yahweh of Armies says: “Behold, I will send on them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like rotten figs that can’t be eaten, they are so bad.

paite: Namsau, kial, hipi in ka delhzui ding a, leitung alalna gam tengteng thil mulkimhuaitak in ka bawl ding a, amau ka dalhsakna nam tengteng lak ah hamsethuak ding in, lamdangsak chiat ding in, hamsiatkhum, selphou leh gensiat hi ding in ka bawl ding hi.
english: I will pursue after them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will deliver them to be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth, to be an object of horror, an astonishment, a hissing, and a reproach among all the nations where I have driven them,

paite: Phalvak a thou a ka nasem, zawlnei zang a ka thu na kiang ua ka hon tut khawk asak louh ziak un. TOUPA thupawt in achi; na ngaikhe nuam ngal kei ua, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: because they have not listened to my words,” says Yahweh, “with which I sent to them my servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them; but you would not hear,” says Yahweh.

paite: Huaiziak in nou Jerusalem a kipan a Babulon a ka sawl, saltang tengteng aw, TOUPA thu ngaikhia un.
english: Hear therefore Yahweh’s word, all you captives whom I have sent away from Jerusalem to Babylon.

paite: "Israel' Pathian, sepaihte' TOUPA'N Kolaiah tapa, Ahab leh Maaseiah tapa, Zedekiah ka min sial a na kiang ua zuauthu gen mite tungtang thu ah hichi in achi: Ngai un, Babulon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar khut ah ka mansak ding hi; na mitmuh ngei un athat ding;
english: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and concerning Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesy a lie to you in my name: “Behold, I will deliver them into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon; and he will kill them before your eyes.

paite: Amau thu ah Babulon gam a Judah saltang tengteng in, Babulon kumpipa'n mei a a-em Zedekiah leh Ahab bang mai in TOUPA'N na tung ah hih hen, chih hamse lohna in aneihloh ding uh.
english: A curse will be taken up about them by all the captives of Judah who are in Babylon, saying, ‘Yahweh make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;’

paite: Israel gam ah thil haihuaitak ahih ua, invengte uh zite ang a kawm ua, ka min sial in ka thupiak louh zuauthu agen ziak un; kei atheipa leh atheihpihpa ka hi," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: because they have done foolish things in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbors’ wives, and have spoken words in my name falsely, which I didn’t command them. I am he who knows, and am witness,” says Yahweh.

paite: Nehelam mi, Shemaiah tungtang thu ah nang hichi a na gen ding ahi.
heading: Shemaiah Kiang A Laikhak
english: Concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite you shall speak, saying,

paite: Israel' Pathian, Sepaihte' TOUPA'N hichi in achi, Jerusalem mipi tengtengte kiang ah nangmah min mahmah in lai na khak hi.
english: “Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘Because you have sent letters in your own name to all the people who are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, and to all the priests, saying,

paite: TOUPA'N siampu Jehoiada sik in siampu ding in nang ahon bawl a, TOUPA inkemmi na hi ua, mihai, zawlnei kichi peuhte kemte, sikkolte na butsak ding ahi.
english: “Yahweh has made you priest in the place of Jehoiada the priest, that there may be officers in Yahweh’s house, for every man who is crazy and makes himself a prophet, that you should put him in the stocks and in shackles.

paite: Huchi in bangziak a Anathoth a mi Jeremiah, na kiang ua zawlnei kichi na taihilh louh uh?
english: Now therefore, why have you not rebuked Jeremiah of Anathoth, who makes himself a prophet to you,

paite: Babulon gam ah i kiang uah, "Saltanna ding asawt ding a, inn lam unla, hiai ah teng un, huan bawl unla, agah ne un, chih thu ahon khak hi," chi in.
english: because he has sent to us in Babylon, saying, The captivity is long. Build houses, and dwell in them. Plant gardens, and eat their fruit?”’”

paite: Huan siampu Zephaniah in huai laikhak zawlnei Jeremiah zak in asim hi.
english: Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the hearing of Jeremiah the prophet.

paite: Huchi in Jeremiah kiang ah TOUPA thu ahong tungta.
english: Then Yahweh’s word came to Jeremiah, saying,

paite: Saltangte tengteng kiang ah, Nehelam mi Shemaiah tungtang thu ah TOUPA'N huchi in achi: Ka sawl het louh in Shemaiah in na kiang uah thu agen a, zuauthu nou ahon gingtasak a,
english: “Send to all of the captives, saying, ‘Yahweh says concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: “Because Shemaiah has prophesied to you, and I didn’t send him, and he has caused you to trust in a lie,”

paite: huaiziak in TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai un, Nehelam mi Shemaiah leh asuante ka gawt ding a, hiai mite lak ah mi khat lel leng anei kei ding, ka mite a ding a thil hoih ka hih ding amu kei ding; TOUPA tung ah helna thu agen ziak in, chih TOUPA thupawt ahi, chi in khak in achi hi.
english: therefore Yahweh says, “Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite and his offspring. He will not have a man to dwell among this people. He won’t see the good that I will do to my people,” says Yahweh, “because he has spoken rebellion against Yahweh.”’”
